newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy gas oil for December arrival.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy gas oil for December arrival.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for deliveries in December, traders said on Tuesday.

The tender seeks 30,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5 and 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil for delivery to Kandla and 30,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Goa or Kandla on the Indian west coast, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
It also seeks 45,000-tonne cargoes of either grade for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the east coast, c-and-f.
The tender closes on October 24 and offers should be valid for two days.
IOC cancelled its previous tender for November delivery and bought just 120,000 tonnes for October delivery.
Some traders said they expected IOC to buy small volumes for December as well due to port congestion.
